body.query: 按大区统计 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.resolved_query: 按大区统计 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.sql: SELECT r.region_name AS 大区, SUM(f.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order f JOIN dim_region r ON f.region_id = r.region_id WHERE f.date_id BETWEEN 20250101 AND 20250331 GROUP BY r.region_name LIMIT 1000
body.feedback_comment: 结果正确但希望按品牌进一步拆分展示

body.resolved_query: 统计华北地区 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.sql: SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额 FROM fact_order fo JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id WHERE dr.region_name = '华北' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' LIMIT 1000

body.query: 统计华东地区 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.resolved_query: 统计华东地区 2025 年第一季度销售额
body.sql:
SELECT SUM(fo.order_amount) AS 销售额
FROM fact_order fo
JOIN dim_region dr ON fo.region_id = dr.region_id
JOIN dim_date dd ON fo.date_id = dd.date_id
WHERE dr.region_name = '华东' AND dd.year = 2025 AND dd.quarter = 'Q1' LIMIT 1000
